verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document Vanta sending alerts for failing tests or configuration drift to Slack, email, or ticketing tools. Webhooks (vanta-docs-4) are a developer building block that does not name test-failure events. The status-page email notifications (vanta-docs-89) cover Vanta's own service incidents, not customer control failures. Generic claims about continuous monitoring and 'flag gaps' do not establish alert delivery where the admin works.

support.subject: As an IT admin, control failures and configuration drift alert me where I work — Slack, email, or ticketing — with enough context to fix the finding
